rationale: The agent correctly authenticated the user via full name + zip and acted only on the user’s orders. It checked order status (pending) before changes and requested/received explicit confirmation before modifying the Bluetooth speaker item. However, the agent updated the delivery address to the NYC address without first obtaining explicit user confirmation after stating the exact change; it said “I will update…” and executed the write immediately. Policy requires explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. Additionally, the agent stated the price difference “has been refunded” without explicit tool confirmation of a refund, which risks asserting unsupported information. These issues fail the pass bar despite otherwise appropriate steps.
